solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A rich Tory caste, subject to reform

definitions.text: A rich Tory caste, subject to reform

indicators.note: something subject to reform is to be remade, so the letters of the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A political jibe at a wealthy Conservative elite that needs reforming.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: the letters of 'A rich Tory caste' rearrange into the answer, and the phrase itself describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: The nobility is the hereditary upper class, a rich caste traditionally aligned with the Tories.

clue.text: Leading member of 1 across seen among all those present

parts.note: the head is the one leading
a count is a nobleman, a member of the aristocracy

explanation.surface: A noble figure turns up in a crowd of attendees.
explanation.definitionFit: A tally of everyone in attendance is a count of all those present.

clue.text: Continue performing in west London

parts.note: performing on stage is acting, ACT
on, as in 'go on' or 'carry on', means continue

explanation.surface: An actor keeps going on stage somewhere in west London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link: the district is in west London. Acton is a district of west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Acton is a suburb in the western part of the capital.

clue.text: Press get Labour's support for heavy industry

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits underneath, so this one goes below the first

parts.note: to press clothes is to iron them
labour is, read as a verb with 's for is, gives works

explanation.surface: Newspapers rallying behind the Labour Party's backing of heavy industry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour's' looks like the political party but reads as 'labour is', i.e. works; 'support' puts it under IRON in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A foundry or smelting plant producing metal is a classic example of heavy industry.

clue.text: Celebrated soprano to accompany half of 9

indicators.note: to accompany is to go alongside, so the next piece follows on directly
half of a six-letter word is its first three letters

parts.note: the answer to 9 down, scales

explanation.surface: A famous singer agreeing to sing alongside half a musical scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Floria Tosca is Puccini's celebrated operatic heroine, a role written for soprano.

clue.text: Italian bread strikes reportedly led by secret agents

indicators.note: led by puts the agents in front of the next piece

parts.note: the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency

indicators.note: reportedly means the word is as heard, a word sounding like the one given

parts.note: batters means strikes repeatedly

explanation.surface: Bakery workers striking under the leadership of spies.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic accent 'batters' sounds the same as the tail of the loaves' name.
explanation.definitionFit: Ciabatta is a flat white loaf from Italy; the plural names several of them.

clue.text: It might describe a more competent seaman

definitions.text: It might describe a more competent seaman

parts.words: It might describe a more competent seaman
parts.note: an able seaman, AB, who is better at the job would be the more able one, so the comparative of able fits him neatly

explanation.surface: A sailor being judged better at the job than another.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke is on the rank 'able seaman': a superior one would be the comparative of that adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: The comparative of able means more competent, playing on the naval rank of able seaman.

clue.text: Some say ash makes a fine cover

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: People claiming that ash produces a good layer of covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A yashmak is a fine veil worn by some Muslim women, a delicate face covering.

clue.text: Sign closely associated with Pisces

definitions.meaning: Libra, the zodiac sign represented by a balance
Pisces is the fish, and fish are covered in small horny plates

explanation.surface: An astrological sign said to be linked to Pisces.
explanation.walkthrough: Pisces is itself a zodiac sign, which tempts one to look for a neighbouring sign; instead it is the fish and its skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Libra is pictured as a weighing balance; fish skin is coated in tiny protective plates.

clue.text: Part of Circle Line rotating daily — this takes skill

indicators.note: rotating turns the piece round so it reads backwards

parts.note: an arc is a part of a circle's curved line
FT is the Financial Times, a daily paper

explanation.surface: A section of the London Underground loop line turning every day.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle line is a London Underground route, but here it is just geometry. 'daily' is this very paper, the FT.
explanation.definitionFit: A craft is a trade or art that demands skill, such as weaving or carpentry.

clue.text: Old British castles rebuilt to form barriers

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters are put together again in a new order

explanation.surface: Ancient British fortresses reconstructed as defensive walls.
explanation.definitionFit: Obstacles and barriers are both things that block the way.

clue.text: Fortune currently invested in Indian city

parts.note: fortune means luck
currently means now, at present

explanation.surface: Wealth being put into an Indian city at present.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invested' suggests money, but 'Fortune' is chance.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucknow is the capital of the state of Uttar Pradesh in northern India.

clue.text: It's required to make coats from 5

definitions.text: It's required to make coats from 5

parts.words: It's required to make coats from 5
parts.note: the letters of the answer to 5 down, the opera heroine, can be rearranged into coats; such a rearrangement is the device named

explanation.surface: Something needed to turn a singer into outerwear.
explanation.walkthrough: The 5 down answer, rearranged, spells COATS: the clue names the very wordplay device that does it.
explanation.definitionFit: A rearrangement of a word's letters into another word is exactly the device that turns one into the other.

clue.text: Puzzle an axeman would leave behind

definitions.meaning: to puzzle someone is to baffle or nonplus them
after felling a tree a woodcutter leaves the base of the trunk in the ground

explanation.surface: A riddle about what a woodcutter leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: To baffle is to stump; the short remnant of a felled trunk is also a stump.

clue.text: Churchwarden eg somehow made vicar, finally — sheer fancy!

parts.note: a churchwarden is a long-stemmed clay tobacco pipe

indicators.note: somehow says the letters are arranged in some other way
finally takes the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A church officer somehow turned into a vicar: pure fantasy!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Churchwarden' looks like a parish official but is a long clay pipe. 'somehow' rearranges MADE plus R into DREAM.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe dream is an unrealistic hope or fantasy, so mere fancy.

clue.text: Correct finance house in Paris, north of the Seine

definitions.text: in Paris, north of the Seine

parts.note: correct means right
a bank is a financial institution

explanation.surface: The proper bank to use in the French capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rive Droite of Paris is the north bank of the Seine, facing downstream.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rive Droite is the name for the northern half of Paris across the river.

clue.text: Earth pig or woodchuck

parts.note: earth means ground, soil
a hog is a pig

explanation.surface: Asking whether an animal is an aardvark-like earth pig or a woodchuck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Earth pig' is the meaning of aardvark, a tempting false lead.
explanation.definitionFit: The woodchuck is another name for the North American marmot also known by this name.

clue.text: Slander exposed by a second Omar Khayyam we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word sounds like the one given

parts.note: Omar Khayyam was a Persian poet

explanation.surface: A defamation revealed by a second poet like Omar Khayyam.
explanation.definitionFit: Casting aspersions means making damaging, defamatory remarks about someone.

clue.text: Italian course for beginners?

parts.note: it reads like a language class for novices, but means the dish that begins an Italian meal

explanation.surface: An introductory Italian language class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' is a meal course, and 'beginners' are starters.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is the Italian starter of cured meats and vegetables served first in a meal.

clue.text: Some "baa", strangely, like tiny living things

indicators.note: strangely means the letters are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: Some odd bleating likened to microscopic creatures.
explanation.definitionFit: These are single-celled organisms, microscopic forms of life.

clue.text: Return copies enclosing one old photograph

indicators.note: enclosing puts the next piece within the turned word
Return says the word is turned to read backwards

parts.note: apes means copies, imitates
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Sending back duplicates that contain a single old picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' turns APES into SEPA, and 'enclosing' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Old photographs were often brown-tinted prints, and such a print is named after that tint.

clue.text: Crazy old man is a tough nut to crack

indicators.note: crazy means the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A mad elderly man who is a difficult person to deal with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a tough nut to crack' is an idiom for a difficult person, but here it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: An almond is a hard-shelled nut that needs cracking open.

clue.text: Outstanding sport centre needs fresh greens right away

indicators.note: the centre of a five-letter word is its third letter
right away means R, for right, is taken out

parts.note: verdure is lush green vegetation

explanation.surface: An excellent sports centre needs new vegetables at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' looks like 'immediately' but removes one R from VERDURE, leaving VERDUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt still outstanding is unpaid past its due date.

clue.text: Small fierce mammal loses head making a stand

indicators.note: loses head means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a weasel is a small ferocious carnivore

explanation.surface: A little ferocious animal beheaded and propped up.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's easel is a stand for holding a canvas.

clue.text: Girl's name — in France she takes the lead

parts.note: elle is French for she

indicators.note: the lead of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A woman's name: in France, she comes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Girl' is a crossword convention for a girl's name; 's is a link, and 'the lead' takes the first letter of 'name'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ellen is a common female given name, so it can stand for a girl.

clue.text: Appropriate spirit for making toast in the wardroom?

definitions.text: Appropriate spirit for making toast in the wardroom?

parts.words: Appropriate spirit for making toast in the wardroom?
parts.note: the wardroom is the officers' mess on a warship, so the fitting drink is the one sailors were traditionally issued

explanation.surface: What drink to raise a toast with in the officers' mess.
explanation.walkthrough: A wardroom is the officers' mess on a Royal Navy ship; sailors were long given a daily tot of rum.
explanation.definitionFit: The dark rum of the Royal Navy's daily tot suits a naval officers' mess toast.

clue.text: Engine noise heard in space after victory

indicators.note: after puts the second piece behind the first

parts.note: room means space

explanation.surface: A car's roar ringing out across the track after a win.
explanation.definitionFit: The roar of a revving motor is imitated by this sound word.

clue.text: How burglars enter near the last resort

parts.note: by means near, beside

indicators.note: resort, read as re-sort, means the letters are sorted again

explanation.surface: Burglars getting in close to the final holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday place but reads as re-sort, rearranging THE LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: Burglars get in secretly and quietly, without being noticed.

clue.text: Some stars in love or just confused

indicators.note: just confused says the letters are simply jumbled

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so O

explanation.surface: A stargazer muddled about being in love or not.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is a prominent constellation, a group of stars.

clue.text: Personal control that Santa's good at? Not initially!

parts.words: that Santa's good at? Not initially!
parts.note: Santa's skill is running his elves; drop the first letter of the answer and that is what remains

explanation.surface: A question about what Father Christmas excels at, with a twist.
explanation.walkthrough: Without its first letter the answer reads as ELF MANAGEMENT, which Santa is good at.
explanation.definitionFit: Running one's own affairs without supervision is personal control.
